fields.Name: T341 - Labels Card List View Toggle
fields.Description: Drives mj-view-toggle which selects between two distinct render branches (.labels-list card grid vs .labels-table) via SetViewMode — a code path unique to this surface.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Version History app (application switcher dropdown next to the logo → 'Version History'), on the Labels surface locate the view toggle control (grid vs list icons) in the toolbar. Switch to list view and confirm a table layout with column headers (Name, Entity, Status, Items, Created) appears; then switch back to card view and confirm the card layout returns. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. If no labels exist, the toggle should still switch the underlying layout mode with an empty state shown.

judgeValidationCriteria: A card/list view toggle control is present in the toolbar and responds to clicks
List view shows a header row with columns (Name/Status/Items/Created); card view shows a card layout (or a valid empty state either way)
Toggling back and forth changes the layout without losing the page
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
